name: softube-ts-tighten-low
description: Clean LOW-band tighten via the Softube Transient Shaper: reduce SUSTAIN on the low band so the kick/snare body & boom tighten while cymbals/hats keep their natural decay. Validated on the Watercolors no-room drum bus (crest up, choke-free, highs preserved). Tighten = NEGATIVE sustain, NOT punch (punch adds an unnatural click). WIDE negative sustain chokes the hats — that is why this is LOW-band.
intended_for: a dry / no-room drum bus or kick/snare stem that needs a tighter, controlled low end without choking the cymbals
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: Tighten = SUSTAIN down + punch 0 (punch pushed = clicky/spitty — Gemini flagged punch+3). LOW band (xover 700) keeps cymbal/hat decay natural; WIDE negative sustain gates the highs. Push sustain toward -6..-8 for more tighten, then re-QC for gate-like choke. Level-independent → no input gain-stage. Verify crest/PLR UP and centroid roughly steady after.
